waybackify bucket verify [flags]

Verify a bucket is a byte-for-byte projection of a root

Prove a remote S3-compatible bucket serves identical content to a local
cache root, in up to four layers: count parity per prefix, a full
metadata sweep (HEAD every cap/), full body verification (GET + rehash
every status:body), and serving parity sampled through the serve
router. Reads through the same store the server serves from.

Credentials come from AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY in the
environment, never flags. Output: a per-layer report on stdout (--json
for the raw report). Exit 0 all layers pass, 1 on any mismatch.

Flags:
  --root|-r <root>    local cache root — the archive of record — required
  --bucket <name>     target bucket name — required
  --endpoint <url>    S3-compatible base endpoint (e.g. https://<acct>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com) — required
  --region <r>        signing region (default auto — right for R2)
  --prefix <p>        key prefix within the bucket
  --sample <n>        Layer 4 sample size per status class (default 3)
  --layer <list>      comma list of layers 1–4 to run (default all)
  --concurrency <n>   in-flight HEAD/GET cap for Layers 2–3 (default 16)
  --json              emit the raw report as JSON
  --out <path>        also write the report to this file
  --help|-h           Show help

part of the wayback.charlie.dev mirror tooling
